text: Both runs are still going; they're walking the pages with Tab.

I ran the automated Trusted Tester checks on both pages. I answered the open questions for the Help page, and left the homepage's 63 open questions unanswered. Everything that depends on them is NEEDS_REVIEW.

**Homepage (https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/)**
- **3.3.2 Labels or Instructions (FAIL):** The "Search..." text box has only placeholder text as its label, and that text disappears once you type.
- **1.3.1 and 4.1.2 (FAIL):** Several buttons have no accessible name. The run found five unnamed buttons. Two of them sit inside the "Filters" panels; I don't have the other three's locations. Another 36 checkbox questions, about what screen readers announce for the filter checkboxes such as "Earth", "Planets & Moons" and "Sun", are unanswered. I scoped these two criteria to form fields, so I listed the unnamed buttons and the search box as the failing elements.
- **2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap, 3.2.1 On Focus and 3.2.2 On Input (PASS):** The tool tabbed through the whole page, and focus was never trapped or moved on its own. The six collapsed controls were not opened.
- **1.4.2, 2.3.1, 3.3.1, 3.3.3 and 3.3.4 (DNA):** There is no auto-playing audio and no flashing. The only form is a site search that accepts any input, so the error and error-prevention criteria don't apply. I decided 3.3.4 myself. The tool still lists it as waiting on one open question.
- **2.1.1 Keyboard:** NEEDS_REVIEW. The tool found mouse-usable controls that keyboard focus never reaches, including an unnamed carousel scroll-right button and the "NASA Science Category" links on cards. Eighteen questions are open about whether keyboard users have an alternative.
- **2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide:** NEEDS_REVIEW. The tool did not finish its check for carousels, tickers and other content that keeps changing by itself.
- **2.4.1, 2.4.3, 2.4.5, 2.4.6, 2.4.7, 3.2.3 and 3.2.4:** NEEDS_REVIEW. The tool couldn't finish these or has open questions.

**Help page (https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/help/)**
- **3.3.2 Labels or Instructions (FAIL):** The "Search" text box has the same placeholder-only label.
- **2.4.5 Multiple Ways (FAIL):** The only way to reach the page is the site navigation, and the site search did not find the page when searching for its heading.
- **1.3.1, 2.1.1, 2.1.2, 3.2.1, 3.2.2 and 4.1.2 (PASS):** The keyboard checks found nothing a mouse user can do that a keyboard user can't. Form fields and buttons have accessible names. The three collapsed FAQ controls were not opened.
- **1.4.2, 2.3.1, 3.3.1, 3.3.3 and 3.3.4 (DNA):** Same reasons as the homepage. The tool recorded 3.3.4 as DNA.
- **2.4.6 Headings and Labels (DNA):** The tool found no visible form label to judge. That gap is covered by the 3.3.2 failure.
- **2.2.2, 2.4.1, 2.4.3, 2.4.7, 3.2.3 and 3.2.4:** NEEDS_REVIEW. The tool couldn't finish these, or I answered "unsure" on its questions. For 2.4.3, the sidebar link boxes overlapped in the screenshot, so I couldn't tell whether the focus order was sensible.
